description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage construction technology team as a Founding Engineer focused on applied AI. You will build the intelligence layer behind tools that interpret construction blueprints and support faster, more affordable construction workflows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop and improve computer vision, machine learning, and AI systems, with a focus on object detection and coordinating models.

 - Explore and apply current computer vision techniques, large language models, and other AI systems to practical problems.

 - Build and ship early prototypes quickly, then refine them using user feedback.

 - Contribute to pragmatic early-stage work beyond core modeling when needed.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on applied computer vision and machine learning experience, including Python and deep learning; the role is open to a broad range of experience levels.

 - Experience building an AI system from 0 to 1 and deploying it in production.

 - Comfort working through ambiguous, challenging problems and taking on practical work beyond modeling.

 - A growth mindset and an empathetic, candid communication style.

 - Motivation to use AI to help make housing more affordable.

 - Construction or social-impact experience is useful, as is having built a product or project adopted or paid for by users.

 - Must be a U.S. citizen.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range: $120,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Full-time, on-site in San Francisco, California. Candidates must be based in the area or willing to relocate.
